jobs.title: CNC Mechaniker (m/w/d) Langdrehen - Fertigung & Prozessoptimierung
jobs.description:
Work Flexibility: Onsite

In Ihrer neuen Rolle als CNC‑Mechaniker (m/w/d) in unserem Programmierteam wirken Sie an der Weiterentwicklung unserer CNC‑Fertigung maßgeblich mit. Sie verbinden technisches Know‑how mit Prozessverständnis, optimieren Langdreh‑Prozesse, treiben neue Fertigungsstrategien voran und sichern gemeinsam mit dem Team eine leistungsfähige, stabile Produktion.

Diese Stelle ist unbefristet zu besetzen.

Unser Angebot an Sie

• Optimieren unserer CNC‑Fertigungsprozesse im Bereich Langdrehen (STAR, TORNOS, Citizen) mit Fokus auf Qualität, Effizienz und Anlagenverfügbarkeit

• Erstellen, Bearbeiten und Schließen von CNC‑Änderungsanträgen sowie die eigenständige Durchführung von Erstbemusterungen

• Hauptverantwortlich für die Bestellungen von Werkzeug, Verbrauchs- und Betriebsmedien innerhalb der Zelle

• Erstellen und pflegen der Einrichtblätter sowie fertigungsrelevante technische Dokumentationen

• Unterstützung des den Shopfloors beim Einrichten von Anlagen sowie bei Störungen, Fehleranalysen und technischen Abklärungen

• Koordinieren von externen Service‑ und Lieferanteneinsätzen und fungieren als technische Ansprechperson

• Begleitung von Maschineninbetriebnahmen sowie die Einführung neuer Prozesse und Anlagen

• Unterstützung bei der Entwicklung und Industrialisierung neuer Produkte in Zusammenarbeit mit Engineering und Advanced Operations

• Sie bringen sich aktiv in kontinuierliche Verbesserungs‑ und Lean‑Initiativen ein, identifizieren Optimierungspotenziale und setzen Maßnahmen um

Das zeichnet Sie aus
Erforderliche Qualifikationen

• Abgeschlossene technische Berufsausbildung (z. B. Mechanik, Zerspanung, Polymechanik oder vergleichbar)

• Mindestens 5 Jahre fundierte Erfahrung im Einrichten- und Einfahren von CNC-Maschinen, inklusive Problem- und Ursachen Diagnose, idealerweise im Langdreh‑Prozess

• Sehr gute mechanische und prozesstechnische Kenntnisse in der CNC‑Bearbeitung

• Selbstständige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise sowie ein hohes Qualitätsbewusstsein und ausgeprägte Verantwortungsbereitschaft

• Klare Kommunikation, Flexibilität und souveräner Umgang mit wechselnden Anforderungen

• Gute Kenntnisse in Microsoft Office (Outlook, Excel, Word)

• Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sowie Grundkenntnisse der englischen Sprache

Bevorzugte Qualifikationen

• Erfahrung in einem produzierenden Unternehmen in der Medizintechnik Branche

• Kompetenz im Langdreh Prozess

• Erfahrung mit CAD-Systemen

• Französischkenntnisse

Vielfalt ist uns wichtig. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen ungeachtet ihrer ethnischen, nationalen oder sozialen Herkunft, des Geschlechts, einer Behinderung, des Alters oder ihrer sexuellen Identität.

Ihre Bewerbung
Wir freuen uns auf Ihre aussagekräftige Online-Bewerbung unter Angabe Ihrer Gehaltsvorstellungen und inklusive aller relevanten Dokumente (Anschreiben, aktueller Lebenslauf, Zeugnisse, ggf. Arbeitserlaubnis). Laden Sie bitte unter dem Punkt „Lebenslauf“ alle Anhänge direkt hoch.

Falls Sie bereits in Besitz einer Arbeitsbewilligung sind, bitten wir Sie die genaue Bewilligungsart mit Ihrer Bewerbung hochzuladen.

Bitte beachten Sie, dass der Anzeigentitel vom internen Stellentitel abweichen kann.

Flessibilità del lavoro: Onsite Nel vostro nuovo ruolo di macchinatrice CNC (m/w/d) nel nostro team di programmazione, avrete un impatto significativo sull'ulteriore sviluppo della nostra produzione CNC. Combinano il know-how tecnico con la comprensione del processo, ottimizzano i processi a lunga durata, guidano nuove strategie di produzione avanti e, insieme al team, garantiscono una produzione efficiente e stabile. Questo organismo deve essere occupato senza indugio. La nostra offerta a voi
• Ottimizzare i nostri processi di produzione CNC nel campo della tornitura lunga (STAR, TORNOS, Citizen) con un focus sulla qualità, l'efficienza e la disponibilità degli impianti
• Creazione, modifica e chiusura degli emendamenti CNC e implementazione indipendente dei campioni iniziali
• Principale responsabilità per l'ordinazione di strumenti, consumo e mezzi operativi all'interno della cella
• Creare e mantenere i fogli di inserto e la documentazione tecnica rilevante per la produzione
• Supporto per i laboratori durante l'installazione e per guasti, analisi dei guasti e spiegazioni tecniche
• Coordinare il servizio esterno e le operazioni dei fornitori e fungere da contatto tecnico
• Accompagnare le operazioni della macchina e introdurre nuovi processi e impianti
• Sostegno allo sviluppo e all'industrializzazione di nuovi prodotti in collaborazione con Engineering e Advanced Operations
• Contribuiscono attivamente al miglioramento continuo e alle iniziative magre, identificano i potenziali di ottimizzazione e implementano misure Questo ti attira qualifiche richieste
• Allenamento tecnico completo (ad esempio meccanica, lavorazione, polimeccanica o simile)
• Almeno 5 anni di esperienza ben fondata nell'impostazione e nell'inserimento di macchine CNC, inclusi problemi e cause di diagnosi, idealmente nel processo di lunga durata
• Molto buone conoscenze di ingegneria meccanica e di processo nella lavorazione CNC
• Metodi di lavoro autonomi e strutturati, nonché un elevato livello di consapevolezza della qualità e forte disponibilità ad assumersi la responsabilità
• Comunicazione chiara, flessibilità e gestione sicura delle mutevoli esigenze
• Buona conoscenza di Microsoft Office (Outlook, Excel, Word)
• Molto buona conoscenza e conoscenza di base della lingua inglese Le qualifiche previste
• Esperienza in un'azienda manifatturiera nel settore delle tecnologie medicali
• Competenza nel processo Langdreh
• Esperienza con sistemi CAD
• Conoscenza francese La diversità è importante per noi. Siamo lieti di ricevere applicazioni da persone indipendentemente dalla loro origine etnica, nazionale o sociale, sesso, disabilità, età o identità sessuale. La tua domanda Non vediamo l'ora della tua significativa applicazione online, specificando le tue aspettative di stipendio e includendo tutti i documenti pertinenti (lettera, curriculum corrente, certificati, permesso di lavoro, se necessario). Work Flexibility: Hybrid

​ Senior Staff Microbiologist - Hybrid

**12 month fixed term contract**

Not lab based

Position requirements
The Senior Staff Microbiologist will be primarily responsible for providing technical input into the sterility compliance of Stryker's product in accordance with relevant regulatory requirements and standards for medical devices, at a muti site / global level. The staff microbiologist will oversee and act as subject matter expert / technical lead in all areas of microbiology and ensuring sustained levels of sterility compliance.

Position Requirements
Will work within the microbiology team, with responsibility to ensure effective and efficient sterility practices, which includes, but not limited to the following:

• Oversight of environmental & utility monitoring, bioburden and endotoxin testing practices and procedures, creating alignment and standardization across multi sites.

• Execution, review and approval of Gamma and Ethylene Oxide sterilization validations and re-qualifications in line with relevant BS EN ISO standards. Assessment of sterility supplier validation.

• Interpreting sampling and monitoring data, applying statistical and analysis techniques, to determine control and trending. Indentifies and initiates when to take action.

• Lead technical input to NC and CAPA resolution within the Microbiology group and across multiple business units / sites. Strong competency in in assessment of effectivity and resulting sterility compliance. Review and approval of CAPA.

• Act as technical lead for microbiology in cross functional groups including product and process issues, rootcausing, projects, initiatives and other business critical forums..

• Subject Matter Expert, audit and review of Supplier quality activities with critical vendors in area of microbiology.

• Review and approval of sterilisation validations and re-qualifications in line with relevant BS EN ISO standards. Assessment of sterility supplier validation.

• Continually identifies opportunity for stabilization of trends, statistical control of processes to allow cost saving.

• Mentors and trains team and cross functional groups as required (induction, GMP etc)

• Subject matter expert to internal & external regulatory requirements, (including but not limited to European RHQ, Division, Corporate, FDA, ISO, MDD, and individual country regulatory requirements)

• Subject matter expert to multi-siye / global procedures, contribute to the development, maintenance and improvements of the policies and procedures to align to best practices, benchmarking against industry leads and regulatory requirements. Input / BPO to corporate documents.

• Coach, mentor and train other functions in area of sterility and monitoring.

• Support of, ensure compliance of new products to sites’ sterility standards. Ensure successful integration of products into validated processes.

• Oversight & approval of biocompatible assessments of components, materials and consumables used in the manufacture of Stryker product.

• Provides Technical Assessment for completion of Risk Assessment for SofHA in area of sterility and microbiology. Assessment and approval of acceptance of resolution to quality issues including concession management.

• Demonstrate technical supervisory capabilities and leads projects to completion.

• Bachelor degree Microbiology or equivalent/ related subject required, with 6 years Microbiology related experience

• Minimum of 8 years in Quality/Regulatory Affairs environment.

• Experience in interacting with regulatory agencies (FDA, MoH, TUV, etc.) required.

• Lead auditor certification desirable.

• Thorough knowledge and understanding of US and International Medical Device Regulations and standards in area of expertise (Microbiology)

• Must possess strong communication, project management and influencing skills as well as have the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.

Work Flexibility: Field-based

Working in part of Stryker’s Peripheral Vascular division, a unique opportunity has arisen for a motivated, driven, and successful Regional Sales Manager to lead a team of Sales Representatives across Switzerland and Austria.

At Stryker, we look for sales leaders that can motivate, guide, and oversee the success of your region, whilst fostering a strong partnership with our customers and making healthcare better through the use of our industry leading products and services.

You will be responsible for the overall management of your region; developing and leading your team, and taking ownership for sales performance and budgets within your territory. The role also contributes to broader country-level commercial execution by supporting strategic initiatives, key accounts, and therapy adoption priorities aligned with EMEA objectives.

Opportunities for maximising customer service along with acquiring new customers will be a pivotal part of your role, so a proven history of delivering exceptional results (individually and through your team) over an extended period is key. You will passionately drive performance with accountability & integrity.

Key Responsibilities

Reporting directly into the regional BUM, you will lead a sales team to ensure that financial & performance objectives are met.

• Accurately forecast business and drive a sustainable, long-term regional sales pipeline aligned with country and EMEA priorities.

• Attract, develop, engage and lead a high performing sales team, supporting and driving them to accelerate business.

• Support and collaborate with our Enabling Function teams (Marketing, Medical, Reimbursement, Order-to-Cash) to ensure a smooth Order to Cash process is maintained and our customers receive the highest levels of service.

• Ensure positive and detailed account communication between the team and other in-house teams, providing feedback and insights to senior management as required.

• Develop and maintain strategic relationships with key regional and national healthcare systems, key accounts, and influential stakeholders.

• Monitor and analyse sales performance metrics (revenue, activities, conversion rates) and take corrective actions as necessary.

• Embrace & enable change to simplify, scale & innovate, acting as a senior commercial role model within the region.

• Demonstrate proficiency in leading complex sales cycles typically defined as six months or longer with multiple partners, decision-makers, and influencers at multiple levels.

• Provide input into regional business planning, market development initiatives, and therapy adoption strategies in collaboration with region and EMEA leadership.

Other Information
This role will require approximately 50-70% of travel to attend customer sites, along with travel to local, national, and EMEA meetings as required.

Education & special trainings:
Bachelor’s degree preferred in a related field or equivalent commercial and clinical experience.

Location
Job holder must be located in Switzerland or Austria

Experience

• Proven success over at least 5 years within a sales and/or commercial leadership role with demonstrable examples of leading others.

• Demonstrated success in roles requiring advanced strategic account judgment, therapy or patient pathway development, and influence across multidisciplinary stakeholder groups.

• A strong track record of achieving and exceeding targets through individual and team performance.

• Ideally product and sales knowledge in the Medical Devices sector, or experience within a complex healthcare or theatre environment.

• Commercial skills in leading a profit centre, with experience contributing beyond a single territory to broader market or regional objectives.

• Experience using CRM systems and strong MS Office skills.

• Experience in the Vascular therapy area is preferred

Competencies

• Strong commercial acumen and strategic mindset

• Initiative-taking and results-dri

• Competenze commerciali nella guida di un centro di profitto, con esperienza che contribuisce al di là di un unico territorio ad obiettivi di mercato più ampi o regionali.
